g.text: SCR11 — Client pairing
Kotlin Compose screen definition · FR-KT-02 / canonical client identity · blueprint2.0 design only
Service Running (desired running) · MCP ready · ADB offline · view ready · catalog ready · ARC disabled · 10
Phone390dp: Enrollment flow and protected single-use reveal are separate pages; never show secret on overview. Modal drawer below840dp; persistent rail
at840dp+. Back returns previous detail, with Discard/Stay for dirty drafts. Landscape: Same IDs and authorization; wide layout only when available
width>=840dp; never shrink protected actions below48dp.
SCR11.C01 · Generate pairing challenge
Fields: Flow,server TLS fingerprint,attempt nonce/expiry and exact requested client label
Local SCR09 authorizes opening a pairing window; separate action creates60s attempt
Failure: Window/attempt expiry closes it; no principal exists until proof and separate exact owner commit
SCR11.C02 · Cancel pairing
Fields: Current attempt ID,state and original expiry
Cancel only an uncommitted attempt and erase bootstrap secret
Failure: Committed client cannot be unpaired here; revoke it explicitly on SCR02
SCR11.C03 · Open navigation
Fields: SCR01..SCR08,SCR10,SCR11; protected review only via exact command
Open all local destinations through phone drawer or wide rail; Back returns previous screen
Failure: Dirty draft requires Discard/Stay; navigation never commits configuration
SCR11.C04 · Choose pairing flow
Fields: Helper requires paired_tls; manual credential generation/reveal is local-only
Choose manual_bearer_setup or pairing_helper_v1 before creating attempt
Failure: Reduced HTTP cannot enable pairing; no implicit OAuth endpoint
SCR11.C05 · Inspect submitted client proof
Fields: Nonce,Origin,endpoint,requested label and server-certificate proof; no fabricated client key
Inspect authenticated submitted proof and pinned enrollment transcript
Failure: Wrong proof/origin rejects attempt without creating client
SCR11.C06 · Review exact client commit
Fields: Attempt/principal kind/client label and all initial rules Deny
Open fresh SCR09 exact enrollment commit before nonce expires
Failure: Expiry/changed proof requires new attempt; approval never directly grants device calls
SCR11.C07 · Reveal/share manual bearer once
Fields: Selected client kind; app stores verifier and Keystore-protected secret reference only when required
Generate/rotate manual bearer under fresh exact SCR09 review and reveal once
Failure: Protected reveal is not an ARC root; copy uses explicit selected-recipient share, never logs; cancel before reveal erases pending secret
State definitions — exact enabled/disabled controls, effects and recovery
SCR11.S0 · Enrollment flow selected: no principal
Disabled: SCR11.C02, SCR11.C05, SCR11.C06, SCR11.C07
Effect: Window/attempt not yet created; choose helper or manual profile.
Recovery: Generate local challenge; all future device rules begin Deny.
SCR11.S1 · Attempt expired
Disabled: SCR11.C02, SCR11.C05, SCR11.C06, SCR11.C07
Effect: Bootstrap secret erased; no principal/grant committed.
Recovery: Create new attempt only under still-valid local pairing window.
SCR11.S2 · Proof/origin rejected
Disabled: SCR11.C02, SCR11.C05, SCR11.C06, SCR11.C07
Effect: Wrong proof or endpoint pin creates no client and closes attempt.
Recovery: Inspect sanitized reason then create a new attempt; never approve rejected proof.
SCR11.S3 · Cancelled uncommitted attempt
Disabled: SCR11.C02, SCR11.C05, SCR11.C06, SCR11.C07
Effect: Secret erased; no client exists from this attempt.
Recovery: Choose a new flow or return; cannot cancel a previously committed client.
SCR11.S4 · Proof submitted: exact owner commit pending
Disabled: SCR11.C01, SCR11.C04, SCR11.C07
Effect: Nonce/Origin/endpoint proof visible; still no principal.
Recovery: Open SCR09 fresh exact commit before60s expiry, or cancel.
SCR11.S5 · Paired: all rules Deny
Disabled: SCR11.C01, SCR11.C02, SCR11.C04, SCR11.C05, SCR11.C06
Effect: Principal committed; token disclosure does not approve Android capability.
Recovery: Return SCR02 to separately review exact grants; revoke there to remove client.
SCR11.S6 · Manual bearer sealed: protected one-time reveal
Disabled: SCR11.C01, SCR11.C02, SCR11.C04, SCR11.C05, SCR11.C06
Effect: Owner-issued verifier stored; secret view/share excluded from ARC/capture/logs.
Recovery: Reveal/share once to explicit recipient; cancel erases pending reveal, not a committed principal.
